course_name_original: UE Physique pour le génie électrique
syllabus_topics: Electrostatics: Coulomb force and Electric Field (Symmetry rules, continuity properties, Electric field flux (field tube, Gauss's theorem))
Electrostatics: Energy properties (Work of the electric force, Potential energy and potential function, Energy of a charge distribution)
Electrostatics: Electrical conductors (Shielding, Field at the surface and Electrostatic Pressure, Capacities and influence coefficients: application to capacitors)
Magnetostatics: Study of magnetic fields produced by current circulations (stationary) or permanent magnetizations
Magnetostatics: Symmetry properties of the magnetostatic field
Magnetostatics: Biot and Savart law, Ampère's theorem
Wave Propagation: Propagation in a neutral medium
Wave Propagation: Reflection of an electromagnetic wave
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
